newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Motorola to expand in Cork, creating 300 jobS.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to expand in Cork, creating 300 jobS.

text.p: Motorola is to expand its cellular infrastructure European software centre in Cork, creating 300 new jobs within the next four years, the Irish government said on Friday.

The expansion, which is supported by industrial development agency IDA Ireland, involves an investment of 20 million Irish pounds and will bring total employment at the centre to 500, a government statement said.
The new expansion in Cork will involve the software development and support programmes for both analogue cellular technology and the GSM system in telecommunications.
Motorola recently invested 110 million Irish pounds to expand its manufacturing facilities in Dublin.
The company employs over 1,500 people in Ireland.
